name: Siftidy
subtitle: Private photo cleanup for iPhone
description: Siftidy helps review and safely organize your Apple Photos library on device. Signed iOS builds will appear here when published.

apps.name: Siftidy
apps.subtitle: Review and clean your Photos library privately
apps.localizedDescription: Review images and videos, select what to delete, and keep your photos on your own device.

versions.localizedDescription: Unsigned IPA for AltStore Classic re-signing; universal macOS ZIP and DMG for Intel and Apple Silicon (not notarized). Back up irreplaceable photos before testing.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Siftidy only changes your Photos library when you confirm an action.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Siftidy needs access to show, review and optionally delete media you select.
